name: wild-island-survival
description: WILD ISLAND: SURVIVAL 2.0 - Three.js survival + online multiplayer

scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/android-config.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-config.js
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:debug:unix: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.server: cd server && npm install && node server.js
